name: app-blue-dotted-semicircle-gauges-user-research-slide
title: Dotted Semicircle Gauges for User Research
whatItIs: A lavender slide titled User Research with a plane on a progress bar, a paragraph, and three semicircle gauges made of a blue arc and radial dot fans with dark percentage discs (50%, 75%, 85%) labelled Flight Booking, Trip Management and Hotel Booking, with a chart tile and sky phone below.
whatItMeans: Radial dot fans make percentages feel like rays of a sun, and each gauge is labelled simply.
techniques: Blue arc with an airplane marker at the end
Radial fan of dots shrinking toward the centre
Dark percentage disc at the gauge centre
Three gauges arranged as a triangle
Title with the second word in blue gradient

vocabulary.definition: Dots radiating from a centre in decreasing size.
A small dark circle holding a number.
